description: This file defines the interface for managing block sources in a reftable system, including functions for opening, reading, sizing, and releasing block data.

methods.name: block_source_close
methods.description: Closes the block source and releases associated resources.

methods.name: block_source_read_data
methods.description: Reads a block of data of specified size from the source at a given offset.

methods.name: block_source_size
methods.description: Returns the total size of the underlying resource.

methods.name: block_source_release_data
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a block data object, returning it to its source.

methods.name: block_source_from_buf
methods.description: Creates an in-memory block source for reading reftables from a buffer.
